title: Institutional Funding Partnership Map
description: Four ongoing funding needs, four institutional partners, and the five connections between them. Two nodes carry more than one line, and those are the ones worth studying.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Expenses and Building Funding Partnerships

educational.audience: Club leaders and treasurers planning funding beyond the first year

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a specific ongoing club funding need, the learner examines which institutional partnership from this chapter best addresses it.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-explore bipartite need-to-partner map with a detail panel per node
pedagogical.assessment: Name an ongoing club cost and ask which partner addresses it, and which single relationship addresses the most.
